comparison.objective: Separate finishing media from parts, versus function-test an emergency stop and controlled restart.
comparison.physical_skill: Bimanual manipulation of a loaded screen versus pressing, twist-releasing and sequencing machine controls.
comparison.success_condition: Physical separation and stable released placement, versus observed stop, release dwell, deliberate restart and final control clearance.
comparison.reason: The machine-state trajectory test has no meaningful manipulation overlap with screening.
